title: gsmarena device slug index (split with box-reasoning)
why: The OTHER binding constraint. 22,173 of 34,261 rows have no chipset, so the chipset lane can only see 84 devices. Chipset comes from gsmarena spec pages, and reaching them needs a device->slug index. gsmarena answers on BOTH boxes, so this is not about unblocking — it is about not pulling ~30 brand pages plus hundreds of device pages from a single address. You take the second half.
control: the Samsung brand page is fetched first and asserted to contain device links; if it does not, the run reports blocked rather than an empty index
expect: RE-RUN REQUIRED with --force. The first attempt returned outcome=empty because MY parser was broken twice: it first required quoted href attributes (matched nothing), then matched the 36-entry nav dropdown instead of the 125-entry brand table. Both fixed, fixtures added, and a MIN_BRANDS floor of 80 now REFUSES a plausible-looking partial index. Do NOT touch res.php3?sSearch= — Turnstile-gated, 200 with a 2,748B challenge page. 2s delay, stop and report on any 429. DELAY IS 5.0, NOT 2.0 — the asking box triggered a 429 on gsmarena by running overlapping crawls, so the per-host budget is already spent for today. Never lower it without saying so.
